title: 胸腔內科
intro: 氣喘、COPD、間質性肺病、肺癌診斷與支氣管鏡介入。 本科程序庫由課程工序生成，並標示為模板生成。
introEn: Asthma, COPD, interstitial lung disease, lung cancer diagnosis and bronchoscopic intervention. This library is generated from the course steps and labelled as template-generated.

procedures.title: 軟式支氣管鏡
procedures.patient: 依課程「軟式支氣管鏡」設定的虛擬情境：氣道解剖、支氣管肺泡灌洗、切片與併發症。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Flexible bronchoscopy": Airway anatomy, bronchoalveolar lavage, biopsy and complications. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
